name: Upkeep
author: Aidan Timson
description: What needs you in Upkeep, each item linked to its dashboard page

barWidget.description: Counts what needs you in Upkeep and lists it in a panel, each item opening its dashboard page. Left click opens the panel, right click opens the dashboard, middle click refreshes.

schema.label: Primary output
schema.description: Optional output name used when primary output only is enabled.

schema.label: Dashboard address
schema.description: The dashboard's direct address, such as http://homeassistant.local:7272. Empty uses $UPKEEP_SERVER.

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often upkeep status is read.

schema.label: Show when nothing needs you
schema.description: Keep the icon in the bar while nothing needs you and a worker is live.

schema.label: Hide overnight
schema.description: Hide during the workspace context's quiet hours while no Herdr terminal is attached.

schema.label: Hide while Herdr is detached
schema.description: Hide while no Herdr terminal is attached. The panel shortcut still opens it.
